arguments.sql_query:
WITH adhd_concepts AS (
  SELECT descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
  FROM omop.concept_ancestor
  WHERE ancestor_concept_id IN (438409,4149904,4149353,4253962,45765796,40480225,440086)
  UNION SELECT 438409 UNION SELECT 4149904 UNION SELECT 4149353 UNION SELECT 4253962 UNION SELECT 45765796 UNION SELECT 40480225 UNION SELECT 440086
),
adhd_patients AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT person_id
  FROM omop.condition_occurrence co
  JOIN adhd_concepts ac ON co.condition_concept_id = ac.concept_id
),
ingredients AS (
  SELECT * FROM (VALUES
    (705944,'methylphenidate','Dopamine/norepinephrine: DAT/NET reuptake inhibition'),
    (731533,'dexmethylphenidate','Dopamine/norepinephrine: DAT/NET reuptake inhibition'),
    (714785,'amphetamine','Dopamine/norepinephrine: monoamine release/reuptake'),
    (719311,'dextroamphetamine','Dopamine/norepinephrine: monoamine release/reuptake'),
    (709567,'lisdexamfetamine','Dopamine/norepinephrine: monoamine release/reuptake'),
    (742185,'atomoxetine','Norepinephrine: selective NET inhibition'),
    (19008261,'viloxazine','Norepinephrine/serotonin modulation'),
    (1344965,'guanfacine','Noradrenergic: alpha-2A agonism'),
    (1398937,'clonidine','Noradrenergic: alpha-2 agonism'),
    (750982,'bupropion','Dopamine/norepinephrine: NDRI'),
    (710650,'modafinil','Dopamine/wakefulness pathway')
  ) AS v(ingredient_concept_id, ingredient, pathway)
),
rx AS (
  SELECT de.person_id, de.drug_exposure_id, de.drug_concept_id, i.ingredient, i.pathway
  FROM omop.drug_exposure de
  JOIN adhd_patients ap ON ap.person_id = de.person_id
  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON ca.descendant_concept_id = de.drug_concept_id
  JOIN ingredients i ON i.ingredient_concept_id = ca.ancestor_concept_id
)
SELECT ingredient, pathway, COUNT(*) AS exposure_records, COUNT(DISTINCT person_id) AS patients
FROM rx
GROUP BY ingredient, pathway
ORDER BY patients DESC, exposure_records DESC;
